markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Every signal agrees on Benign and the input is not flagged, despite simulated blur [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu <1% | Overwhelmingly Benign |
| Conformal set | Benign only, 90% level | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.00 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign | Unanimous [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Score well below typical, leaning away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score; weak spot check (8/20), treat cautiously [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score, associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Score far below typical, associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 beyond random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI -0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. TILs (8/20) is Weak.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (simulated, severity 3) altered features the model relies on; reliability AUROC is only 0.69.
- Regions 1 and 6 show high per-region invasive risk (68%, 74%) despite image-level risk of 0%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6** — rule out an invasive focus behind the high per-region risk.
2. **Region 8** — confirm stroma is non-infiltrative; strongest region for tumor-infiltrating stroma.
3. **Region 11** — check nuclear atypia; blur may hide pleomorphism.
